issue_title: Messaging v2: 'Your AI advisor' reposition — organize data, build processes, run agents; choose-your-AI ladder
problem_statement:
Messaging v2: 'Your AI advisor' reposition — organize data, build processes, run agents; choose-your-AI ladder

Mark, in chat 2026-07-31 (minutes after Direction A shipped via #279), sketched the next messaging evolution. Raw input, two messages:

> "We give you an assistant that runs on any AI you choose. It helps you organize your data, build the processes and then runs the agents. You own your data, you choose your AI and we make it happen. And it's self-improving — the more you use it the better it gets and the more productive you are. You can start small with ChatGPT and Claude and then evolve as the AI industry evolves — eventually run it with your favorite autonomous agents like Hermes and OpenClaw."

> "I think it's your AI advisor, not your agent team. What we provide is a way for non-technical people to run things."

## What this changes (pending Mark's copy pick — iterate in chat before implementing)

1. **Category identity:** `categoryLine` "Your agent team to run the business" → an **AI advisor** frame. Advisor is the interface/brain; agents remain the machinery it runs. Touches categoryLine, hero, SEO titles ("Your Agent Team to Run the Business"), crew framing, and the UNIT-197/UNIT-25 contract sensors.
2. **The advisor arc:** organize your data → build the processes → run the agents. (Maps to Cortex → recipes/processes → Website/Answering/Visibility/Foreman.)
3. **Adoption ladder for the AI side:** start small with ChatGPT/Claude → evolve as the industry evolves → autonomous agents (Hermes, OpenClaw named as examples). Mirrors the SPA→native ladder. HONESTY GATE: frame as where the road goes, not as tested integrations — no vaporware theater; MCP is the mechanism that makes the claim true in principle.
4. **Self-improving:** "the more you use it the better it gets" — extends the existing compounding block (which #279 already made double-sided: models + your data).

## Keep (already true under advisor framing)

- themeLine "Run your business. We'll handle the AI." (#279) — the advisor is who "we" is
- Ownership creed; "you own your data, you choose your AI, we make it happen" tricolon is candidate copy
- Live/waitlist honesty; SPA→native path

Do not implement until Mark picks final copy in chat — this issue is the queue container.
